title: euphrasia collina subsp. tetragona
intro: Euphrasia collina subsp. tetragona, commonly known as Eyebright, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe eye irritations and reduce inflammation, making it a popular remedy for conjunctivitis and other eye conditions. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia collina subsp. tetragona are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect and support eye health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
